name: Counselor in Training (CIT) and Future Leaders Programs, Moraga Day Camp
org: Town of Moraga Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Learn to be a camp leader at the Moraga Day Camp. You shadow Recreation Leaders and help with games, crafts and activities. You also learn how camp programs are planned. CITs help guide the younger campers.
who_can_apply: In 2026, Future Leaders was for age 12 or 13. Counselors in Training was for age 14. Ages were counted on June 8, 2026. You must go to a required orientation and a week of training. You must also interview, and an interview does not promise a spot.
pay_detail: $250 per session for Moraga residents. $270 per session for non-residents.
duration: 4-week blocks with weekly AM or PM shifts; most weeks have one full day, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM
deadline_text: The 2026 interviews were April 13 to 17, 2026. The page lists the sessions as June 15 to July 11 and July 14 to August 8, with no year. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up for an interview time in the Moraga Parks and Recreation online catalog. The link is on the program page. An interview does not promise you a spot. If chosen, you pick the weeks you can come.
notes: In 2026 the orientation was May 7 and training was June 8 to 12. The page says CITs gain hands-on experience that prepares them for possible future jobs with Moraga Parks and Recreation. The town website also has a Summer Jobs page.
